```{r setup, include=FALSE}
position_dodge <- function(width = NULL, preserve = "total") {
  ggproto(NULL, PositionDodge,
          width = width,
          preserve = rlang::arg_match0(preserve, c("total", "single"))
  )
}

#' @rdname ggplot2-ggproto
#' @format NULL
#' @usage NULL
#' @export
PositionDodge <- ggproto(
  `_class` = "PositionDodge",
  `_inherit` = ggplot2::Position,
  width = NULL,
  preserve = "total",
  setup_params = function(self, data) {
    flipped_aes <- has_flipped_aes(data)
    data <- flip_data(data, flipped_aes)
    if (is.null(data$xmin) &&
        is.null(data$xmax) && is.null(self$width)) {
      cli::cli_warn(c("Width not defined",
                      "i" = "Set with {.code position_dodge(width = ...)}"))
    }
    
    if (identical(self$preserve, "total")) {
      n <- NULL
    } else {
      panels <- unname(split(data, data$PANEL))
      ns <- vapply(panels,
                   function(panel) {
                     # we need to find the maximum number of times that the
                     # same xmin is used, but making sure we count each group
                     # only once
                     if (is.null(panel$group))
                       return(1)
                     groups <-
                       unname(split(panel, panel$group))
                     xmins <-
                       vapply(groups, function(group)
                         group$xmin[1], double(1))
                     max(table(xmins))
                   },
                   double(1))
      n <- max(ns)
    }
    
    list(width = self$width,
         n = n,
         flipped_aes = flipped_aes)
  },
  
  setup_data = function(self, data, params) {
    data <- flip_data(data, params$flipped_aes)
    if (!"x" %in% names(data) &&
        all(c("xmin", "xmax") %in% names(data))) {
      data$x <- (data$xmin + data$xmax) / 2
    }
    flip_data(data, params$flipped_aes)
  },
  
  compute_panel = function(data, params, scales) {
    data <- flip_data(data, params$flipped_aes)
    collided <- ggplot2:::collide(
      data,
      params$width,
      name = "position_dodge",
      strategy = pos_dodge,
      n = params$n,
      check.width = FALSE
    )
    flip_data(collided, params$flipped_aes)
  }
)

# Dodge overlapping interval.
# Assumes that each set has the same horizontal position.
pos_dodge <- function(df, width, n = NULL) {
  unique_count <- vctrs::vec_unique_count(df$group)
  if (is.null(n)) {
    n <- unique_count
  }
  
  if (n == 1)
    return(df)
  
  if (!all(c("xmin", "xmax") %in% names(df))) {
    df$xmin <- df$x
    df$xmax <- df$x
  }
  
  d_width <- max(df$xmax - df$xmin)
  
  # Have a new group index from 1 to number of groups.
  # This might be needed if the group numbers in this set don't include all of 1:n
  groupidx <- match(df$group, sort(ggplot2:::unique0(df$group)))

  # Find the center for each group, then use that to calculate xmin and xmax
  df$x <- df$x + width * ((groupidx - 0.5) / unique_count - .5)
  df$xmin <- df$x - d_width / n / 2
  df$xmax <- df$x + d_width / n / 2
  
  df
}
```

``` {r Genetic analysis functions, echo = FALSE}
generate_mst_from_mlst <- function(mlst_df) {
  
  # Build matrix
  profile_mat <-
    as.matrix(mlst_df %>% 
              tibble::column_to_rownames("ST"))

  # Calculate Hamming distances
  profile_distances_mat <-
    as.matrix(proxy::dist(profile_mat,
                          method = function(a, b) sum(a != b)) )
  
  # Indices where distance == 1
  slv_idx <- which(profile_distances_mat == 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  # Keep only upper triangle to avoid duplicate pairs (i<j)
  slv_idx <- slv_idx[slv_idx[, 1] < slv_idx[, 2], , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Build the edge list data frame: two profile name columns + distance
  slv_connections <- data.frame(
    mlst_1 = rownames(profile_distances_mat)[slv_idx[, 1]],
    mlst_2 = colnames(profile_distances_mat)[slv_idx[, 2]]
  )
  
  slv_graph <- graph_from_data_frame(
    d = slv_connections,  # igraph uses 'weight' as the edge attribute name
    directed = FALSE
  )
  
  mlst_mst <- igraph::mst(slv_graph)
  return(mlst_mst)
  
}

# Normalize bases to uppercase and map U->T, "."->"-"
normalise_bases <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(x)
  x[x == "U"] <- "T"
  x[x == "."] <- "-"
  x
}

# Allowed IUPAC DNA bases + gap
allowed <- c("A","C","G","T","N","R","Y","S","W","K","M","B","D","H","V","-")

# Validate a per-base character vector
is_valid_base_vec <- function(x) {
  x2 <- normalise_bases(x)
  all(x2 %in% allowed)
}

# Convert DNAbin or per-base character vector to a sanitized DNA string; return NULL if invalid
safe_dna_string_or_null <- function(x) {
  s <- if (inherits(x, "DNAbin")) {
    paste0(as.character(x), collapse = "")
  } else if (is.character(x)) {
    paste0(x, collapse = "")
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
  s <- toupper(s)
  s <- chartr("U", "T", s)
  s <- gsub("\\.", "-", s)
  invalid <- gsub("[ACGTNRYSWKMBVDH-]", "", s)
  if (nchar(invalid) > 0) return(NULL)
  return(s)
}

# Align two sequences; return a tibble of mismatches or NULL if invalid
mismatch_tbl_aligned <- function(seq_from, seq_to, ignore = c("-", "N")) {
  s_from <- safe_dna_string_or_null(seq_from)
  s_to   <- safe_dna_string_or_null(seq_to)
  if (is.null(s_from) || is.null(s_to)) return(NULL)

  aln <- pairwiseAlignment(DNAString(s_from), DNAString(s_to),
                           type = "global", substitutionMatrix = NULL,
                           gapOpening = 5, gapExtension = 2)

  a_from <- as.character(pattern(aln))
  a_to   <- as.character(subject(aln))
  cf <- normalise_bases(strsplit(a_from, "")[[1]])
  ct <- normalise_bases(strsplit(a_to, "")[[1]])

  keep <- !(cf %in% ignore | ct %in% ignore)
  cf2 <- cf[keep]; ct2 <- ct[keep]
  pos <- which(cf2 != ct2)

  if (length(pos) == 0) {
    # Return an empty tibble (this is a valid comparison with zero mismatches)
    return(tibble(pos = integer(), base_from = character(), base_to = character()))
  }

  return(tibble(pos = pos, base_from = cf2[pos], base_to = ct2[pos]))
}

# Compare two sequences; return tibble of mismatches or NULL to skip invalid pairs
mismatch_tbl_dnabin <- function(seq_from, seq_to, ignore = c("-", "N")) {
  if (is.null(seq_from) || is.null(seq_to)) return(NULL)

  cf <- normalise_bases(as.character(seq_from))
  ct <- normalise_bases(as.character(seq_to))

  # Skip invalid characters by returning NULL
  if (!is_valid_base_vec(cf) || !is_valid_base_vec(ct)) return(NULL)

  # Align if lengths differ; otherwise compare directly
  #if (length(cf) != length(ct)) {
    return(mismatch_tbl_aligned(seq_from, seq_to, ignore = ignore))
  #}

  keep <- !(cf %in% ignore | ct %in% ignore)
  cf2 <- cf[keep]; ct2 <- ct[keep]
  pos <- which(cf2 != ct2)

  if (length(pos) == 0) {
    return(tibble(pos = integer(), base_from = character(), base_to = character()))
  }

  return(tibble(pos = pos, base_from = cf2[pos], base_to = ct2[pos]))
}

read_with_seqinr_dnabin_list <- function(files) {
  out <- structure(list(), class = c("DNAbin","list"))
  for (f in files) {
    x <- seqinr::read.fasta(f, as.string = FALSE, seqtype = "DNA", set.attributes = FALSE)
    for (nm in names(x)) out[[nm]] <- ape::as.DNAbin(x[[nm]])
  }
  return(out)
}

identify_mismatches_between_slvs <- function(mlst_profile_df, slvs_df, fn = NULL) {

  # Identify the allele (locus) columns
  allele_cols <- setdiff(names(mlst_profile_df), "ST")
  
  # Identify the allele changes between SLVs
  allele_changes_df <-
    slvs_df %>%
      # Avoid name clash between slvs$from/to and allele value columns named "from"/"to"
      dplyr::rename(from_ST = from, to_ST = to) %>%
      # Join profiles for the "from" ST
      dplyr::inner_join(
        mlst_profile_df %>% 
          dplyr::mutate(ST = as.character(ST)) %>% 
          dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(., "_from"), all_of(allele_cols)),
        by = c("from_ST" = "ST")
      ) %>%
      # Join profiles for the "to" ST
      dplyr::inner_join(
        mlst_profile_df %>% 
          dplyr::mutate(ST = as.character(ST)) %>% 
          dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(., "_to"), all_of(allele_cols)),
        by = c("to_ST" = "ST")
      ) %>%
      # Reshape so that each row becomes multiple rows, one per locus,
      # with two columns: `from` (allele number) and `to` (allele number)
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = all_of(c(paste0(allele_cols, "_from"), paste0(allele_cols, "_to"))),
        names_to = c("locus", ".value"),
        names_pattern = "^(.*)_(from|to)$"
      ) %>%
      # Keep the single differing locus (for true SLV edges)
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(from) & !is.na(to) & from != to) %>%
      # Present clean output
      dplyr::select(from_ST, to_ST, locus, allele_from = from, allele_to = to)
  
  mlst_sequences_dna <-
    read_with_seqinr_dnabin_list(
      Sys.glob(fn)
    )
  
  mismatches_df <-
    allele_changes_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        seq_from_id = paste0(locus, "_", allele_from),
        seq_to_id   = paste0(locus, "_", allele_to),
        mismatches  = purrr::pmap(
          list(seq_from_id, seq_to_id),
          function(id_from, id_to) {
            mismatch_tbl_dnabin(mlst_sequences_dna[[id_from]], mlst_sequences_dna[[id_to]])
          }
        ),
        is_invalid  = purrr::map_lgl(mismatches, is.null),
        n_mismatch  = map_int(mismatches,
                              ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_integer_ else nrow(.x))
      ) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
      Classification =
        dplyr::case_when(
          n_mismatch > 2 ~ "Recombination",
          n_mismatch > 0 ~ "Point mutation",
          n_mismatch == 0 ~ "Different lengths"
        )
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Classification != "Different lengths")
  
}

plot_violin_kw <- function(x_var,
                           y_var,
                           data = prophage_rec_df,
                           colour_var = Transformability,
                           shape_var  = Niche,
                           x_lab = NULL,
                           y_lab = NULL) {

  # Convert input names to quosures
  x_quo   <- enquo(x_var)
  y_quo   <- enquo(y_var)
  col_quo <- enquo(colour_var)
  shp_quo <- enquo(shape_var)

  # Kruskal–Wallis test
  df_kw <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!x_quo), !is.na(!!y_quo))

  x_vec <- rlang::eval_tidy(x_quo, df_kw)
  y_vec <- rlang::eval_tidy(y_quo, df_kw)

  kw_res <- wilcox.test(y_vec~x_vec)  # y ~ x
  p_val <- kw_res$p.value
  pval_label <- paste0("Wilcoxon~rank~sum~test~italic(p) == ", signif(p_val, 3))

  # Build plot
  p <- ggplot(data,
              aes(x = !!x_quo,
                  y = !!y_quo)) +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.5),
                alpha = 0.3,
                colour = "grey80") +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(colour = !!col_quo, shape = !!shp_quo),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0),
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = niche_palette) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = transformability_palette) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = c(0,0.15)))

  # Annotate p-value
  p <- p +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = pval_label,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.25,
      size = 3.5,
      parse = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
          axis.title.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 5.5, r = 5.5, b = 5.5, l = 15))

  if (!is.null(x_lab)) p <- p + xlab(x_lab)
  if (!is.null(y_lab)) p <- p + ylab(y_lab)

  p
}

# ---- Unified mobile element schema ------------------------------------------
# Expected output columns:
# Species, Accession, Genome_length_bp, Element_bp, Element_count,
# Element_type, Detector, Density_bp_per_Mbp

standardise_mobile_df <- function(df,
                                  species_col,
                                  accession_col,
                                  genome_len_col,
                                  element_bp_col = NULL,
                                  element_count_col = NULL,
                                  element_type = c("prophage","plasmid","inoviridae"),
                                  detector = c("PHASTER","geNomad")) {

  element_type <- match.arg(element_type)
  detector <- match.arg(detector)

  out <- df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Species = .data[[species_col]],
      Accession = .data[[accession_col]],
      Genome_length_bp = as.numeric(.data[[genome_len_col]]),
      Element_bp = if (!is.null(element_bp_col)) as.numeric(.data[[element_bp_col]]) else NA_real_,
      Element_count = if (!is.null(element_count_col)) as.numeric(.data[[element_count_col]]) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Element_type = element_type,
      Detector = detector
    )

  # If bp missing but count present, keep bp as NA (don't invent lengths)
  out %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Density_bp_per_Mbp = (Element_bp / Genome_length_bp) * 1e6
    )
}

# Build one long table from all sources
build_mobile_element_table <- function(phaster_prophage_df = NULL,
                                       genomad_prophage_df = NULL,
                                       plasmid_df = NULL,
                                       inoviridae_df = NULL) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    phaster_prophage_df,
    genomad_prophage_df,
    plasmid_df,
    inoviridae_df
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Species), !is.na(Accession), !is.na(Genome_length_bp))
}

plot_observed_vs_poisson <- function(observed_data,
                                     poisson_summary_data,
                                     # column names
                                     count_col = "count",
                                     species_col = "species",
                                     display_col = "display",
                                     lambda_col = "lambda_hat",
                                     detector_col = "detector",
                                     element_type_col = "element_type",
                                     class_col = "class",
                                     # filter values
                                     detector_value = NULL,
                                     element_type_value = NULL,
                                     class_value = NULL,
                                     # plotting options
                                     x_label = "Count per sample",
                                     facet_scales = "free_y",
                                     bar_fill = "blue",
                                     bar_colour = "blue",
                                     line_colour = "red",
                                     max_count = NULL) {

  # ---- checks ----
  obs_needed <- c(count_col, species_col, display_col, detector_col, element_type_col)
  sum_needed <- c(species_col, display_col, lambda_col, detector_col, element_type_col)

  miss_obs <- setdiff(obs_needed, names(observed_data))
  miss_sum <- setdiff(sum_needed, names(poisson_summary_data))

  if (length(miss_obs) > 0) stop("Observed data missing: ", paste(miss_obs, collapse = ", "))
  if (length(miss_sum) > 0) stop("Poisson summary data missing: ", paste(miss_sum, collapse = ", "))

  if (!is.null(class_value)) {
    if (!(class_col %in% names(observed_data))) stop("Observed data missing class column: ", class_col)
    if (!(class_col %in% names(poisson_summary_data))) stop("Poisson summary data missing class column: ", class_col)
  }

  # ---- filters ----
  obs_f <- observed_data
  sum_f <- poisson_summary_data

  if (!is.null(detector_value)) {
    obs_f <- obs_f %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[detector_col]] == detector_value)
    sum_f <- sum_f %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[detector_col]] == detector_value)
  }
  if (!is.null(element_type_value)) {
    obs_f <- obs_f %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[element_type_col]] == element_type_value)
    sum_f <- sum_f %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[element_type_col]] == element_type_value)
  }
  if (!is.null(class_value)) {
    obs_f <- obs_f %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[class_col]] == class_value)
    sum_f <- sum_f %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[class_col]] == class_value)
  }

  # overlap species
  common_species <- intersect(unique(obs_f[[species_col]]), unique(sum_f[[species_col]]))
  obs_f <- obs_f %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[species_col]] %in% common_species)
  sum_f <- sum_f %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[species_col]] %in% common_species)

  if (nrow(obs_f) == 0) stop("No observed rows after filtering.")
  if (nrow(sum_f) == 0) stop("No summary rows after filtering.")

  # ---- compute observed probabilities internally ----
  observed_prob_df <- obs_f %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[species_col]], .data[[display_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(.Total = dplyr::n()) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[species_col]], .data[[display_col]], .data[[count_col]], .Total) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(.Obs_total = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(obs_prob = .Obs_total / .Total)

  # ---- fitted probabilities from lambda ----
  if (is.null(max_count)) max_count <- max(obs_f[[count_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  count_grid <- tibble::tibble(.count_tmp = 0:max_count)

  fitted_data <- sum_f %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .species_tmp = dplyr::all_of(species_col),
      .display_tmp = dplyr::all_of(display_col),
      .lambda_tmp  = dplyr::all_of(lambda_col)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    tidyr::crossing(count_grid) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(fitted_prob = stats::dpois(.count_tmp, .lambda_tmp))

  names(fitted_data)[names(fitted_data) == ".display_tmp"] <- display_col

  # ---- plot ----
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_col(
      data = observed_prob_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[count_col]], y = obs_prob),
      fill = bar_fill, color = bar_colour, width = 0.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      data = fitted_data,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .count_tmp, y = fitted_prob),
      linewidth = 0.5, linetype = 2, colour = line_colour
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      stats::as.formula(paste0("~", display_col)),
      scales = facet_scales,
      labeller = ggplot2::label_parsed
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
      minor_breaks = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = x_label, y = "Observed probability") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   legend.position = "none")

  list(
    plot = p,
    observed_prob = observed_prob_df,
    fitted_data = fitted_data
  )
}

make_r2_plotmath_label <- function(r2_marg = NA_real_,
                                   r2_cond = NA_real_,
                                   r2_generic = NA_real_,
                                   r2_generic_name = NA_character_,
                                   digits = 3) {
  fmt <- function(x) format(signif(x, digits), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)

  if (!is.na(r2_marg) && !is.na(r2_cond)) {
    return(paste0(
      "italic(R)^2[m] == ", fmt(r2_marg),
      "*'; '*italic(R)^2[c] == ", fmt(r2_cond)
    ))
  }

  if (!is.na(r2_generic)) {
    nm <- ifelse(is.na(r2_generic_name) || r2_generic_name == "", "generic", r2_generic_name)
    subscript <- dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("ferrari", nm, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Ferrari",
      grepl("nakagawa", nm, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Nakagawa",
      grepl("tjur", nm, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Tjur",
      TRUE ~ "generic"
    )
    return(paste0("{italic(R)^2}[", subscript, "] == ", fmt(r2_generic)))
  }

  "italic(R)^2 == NA"
}

plot_rec_vs_element_model <- function(model_fit,
                                      plot_df,
                                      detector_value = NULL,
                                      element_type_value = NULL,
                                      class_value = NULL,
                                      detector_col = "detector",
                                      element_type_col = "element_type",
                                      class_col = "class",
                                      x_var = "lambda_hat",
                                      y_var = "Recombination probability",
                                      y_lwr_col = "asymp.LCL",
                                      y_upr_col = "asymp.UCL",
                                      x_lwr_col = "lambda_lwr",
                                      x_upr_col = "lambda_upr",
                                      label_col = "display_name",
                                      colour_col = "Transformability",
                                      shape_col = "Niche",
                                      x_lab = "Expected number of elements per isolate genome",
                                      y_lab = "Probability of diversification through homologous recombination",
                                      n_grid = 200) {
  
  df <- plot_df

  # Optional filters
  if (!is.null(detector_value)) {
    if (!(detector_col %in% names(df))) stop("Missing detector column: ", detector_col)
    df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[detector_col]] == detector_value)
  }
  if (!is.null(element_type_value)) {
    if (!(element_type_col %in% names(df))) stop("Missing element_type column: ", element_type_col)
    df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[element_type_col]] == element_type_value)
  }
  if (!is.null(class_value)) {
    if (!(class_col %in% names(df))) stop("Missing class column: ", class_col)
    df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[class_col]] == class_value)
  }

  df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[x_var]]), !is.na(.data[[y_var]]))
  if (nrow(df) == 0) stop("No rows left after filtering.")

  # Prediction grid
  newdata_rec <- df %>%
    dplyr::summarise(min_mean = 0,
                     max_mean = max(.data[[x_upr_col]][.data[[x_upr_col]] < Inf], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    { tibble::tibble(!!x_var := seq(.$min_mean, .$max_mean, length.out = n_grid)) }

  emm_rec <- emmeans::emmeans(
    model_fit,
    specs = stats::as.formula(paste0("~", x_var)),
    at    = setNames(list(newdata_rec[[x_var]]), x_var),
    type  = "response"
  )

  pred_df <- tibble::as_tibble(emm_rec) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      prob_fit = response,
      prob_se  = SE,
      prob_lwr = asymp.LCL,
      prob_upr = asymp.UCL
    )

  # p-value
  mod_sum <- summary(model_fit)
  p_val <- mod_sum$coefficients$cond[x_var, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  p_label <- paste0("italic(p) == ", signif(p_val, 3))

  # R2 extraction (supports both generic and mixed-model outputs)
  r2_obj <- performance::r2(model_fit)

  r2_marg <- NA_real_
  r2_cond <- NA_real_
  r2_generic <- NA_real_
  r2_name <- NA_character_

  # mixed-model style
  if (!is.null(r2_obj$R2_marginal) && length(r2_obj$R2_marginal) > 0) {
    r2_marg <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r2_obj$R2_marginal[1]))
  }
  if (!is.null(r2_obj$R2_conditional) && length(r2_obj$R2_conditional) > 0) {
    r2_cond <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r2_obj$R2_conditional[1]))
  }

  # generic style (your case: Ferrari's R2)
  if (!is.null(r2_obj$R2) && length(r2_obj$R2) > 0) {
    r2_generic <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r2_obj$R2[1]))
    r2_name <- names(r2_obj$R2)[1]
    if (is.null(r2_name) || is.na(r2_name) || r2_name == "") r2_name <- "R2"
  }

  r2_label <- make_r2_plotmath_label(
    r2_marg = r2_marg,
    r2_cond = r2_cond,
    r2_generic = r2_generic,
    r2_generic_name = r2_name
  )
  
  # Force scalar character to avoid annotate() type issues
  r2_label <- as.character(r2_label)[1]
  p_label  <- as.character(p_label)[1]
  
  # Build plot
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data[[x_var]],
      y = .data[[y_var]],
      colour = .data[[colour_col]],
      shape = .data[[shape_col]],
      label = .data[[label_col]]
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point() +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data[[x_var]],
      ymin = .data[[y_lwr_col]],
      ymax = .data[[y_upr_col]]
      ),
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbarh(
      ggplot2::aes(
        y = .data[[y_var]],
        xmin = .data[[x_lwr_col]],
        xmax = .data[[x_upr_col]]
      ),
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(data = pred_df, ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = prob_fit),
                       inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.75) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(data = pred_df, ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[x_var]], ymin = prob_lwr, ymax = prob_upr),
                         inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.2, fill = "black") +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(size = 3, force_pull = 0.5, parse = TRUE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = niche_palette) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = transformability_palette,
                        aesthetics = c("colour","fill")) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::annotate("text",
                      x = stats::quantile(df[[x_var]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
                      y = stats::quantile(df[[y_var]], 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
                      label = p_label, parse = TRUE, hjust = 1) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = stats::quantile(df[[x_var]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      y = stats::quantile(df[[y_var]], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      label = r2_label,
      parse = TRUE,
      hjust = 1
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  list(
    plot = p,
    filtered_df = df,
    predictions = pred_df,
    p_value = p_val,
    r2_marginal = r2_marg,
    r2_conditional = r2_cond,
    r2_generic = r2_generic,
    r2_generic_name = r2_name
  )
}

# Exact Poisson CI for rate per isolate
poisson_rate_ci_exact <- function(k, n, conf.level = 0.95) {
  alpha <- 1 - conf.level

  if (is.na(k) || is.na(n) || n <= 0) {
    return(c(lambda = NA_real_, lwr = NA_real_, upr = NA_real_))
  }

  lambda_hat <- k / n

  if (k == 0) {
    lwr <- 0
    upr <- -log(alpha) / n
  } else {
    lwr <- 0.5 * stats::qchisq(alpha / 2, df = 2 * k) / n
    upr <- 0.5 * stats::qchisq(1 - alpha / 2, df = 2 * (k + 1)) / n
  }

  c(lambda = lambda_hat, lwr = lwr, upr = upr)
}

fit_poisson_by_species <- function(df, conf.level = 0.95) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(species, display, detector, element_type) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      dat <- .x
      counts <- dat$count
      n <- nrow(dat)
      k <- sum(counts, na.rm = TRUE)
      alpha <- 1 - conf.level

      if (k == 0) {
        # Exact CI for all-zero case: fitdistrplus cannot fit a degenerate distribution
        tibble::tibble(
          n_isolates     = n,
          k_total        = k,
          lambda_hat     = 0,
          lambda_lwr     = 0,
          lambda_upr     = -log(alpha) / n,
          mean_empirical = 0,
          var_empirical  = 0,
          aic            = NA_real_,
          bic            = NA_real_,
          fit_converged  = NA
        )
      } else {
        tryCatch({
          fit <- fitdistrplus::fitdist(counts, distr = "pois", method = "mle")

          ci <- confint(fit, level = conf.level)

          tibble::tibble(
            n_isolates     = n,
            k_total        = k,
            lambda_hat     = unname(fit$estimate["lambda"]),
            lambda_lwr     = ci["lambda", 1],
            lambda_upr     = ci["lambda", 2],
            mean_empirical = mean(counts, na.rm = TRUE),
            var_empirical  = stats::var(counts, na.rm = TRUE),
            aic            = fit$aic,
            bic            = fit$bic,
            fit_converged  = fit$convergence == 0
          )
        }, error = function(e) {
          tibble::tibble(
            n_isolates     = n,
            k_total        = k,
            lambda_hat     = NA_real_,
            lambda_lwr     = NA_real_,
            lambda_upr     = NA_real_,
            mean_empirical = mean(counts, na.rm = TRUE),
            var_empirical  = stats::var(counts, na.rm = TRUE),
            aic            = NA_real_,
            bic            = NA_real_,
            fit_converged  = FALSE
          )
        })
      }
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

fit_beta_model <- function(in_df, element = NULL, detector_method = NULL) {

  df <- in_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(detector == detector_method, element_type == element) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(`Recombination probability`), !is.na(lambda_hat))

  # Check rows
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    stop("No rows after filtering. Check detector/element values and case.")
  }

  # Beta regression requires 0 < y < 1
  y <- df$`Recombination probability`
  if (any(y <= 0 | y >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    # squeeze into open interval (Smithson & Verkuilen style)
    n <- length(y)
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(`Recombination probability` =
        ((`Recombination probability` * (n - 1)) + 0.5) / n
      )
  }

  # Fit with tryCatch to avoid hard crash
  mod <- tryCatch(
    glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      `Recombination probability` ~ lambda_hat,
      data = df,
      ziformula = ~0,
      dispformula = ~1,
      family = glmmTMB::beta_family(link = "logit")
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      stop("Model fit failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    }
  )

  return(mod)
}

plot_ecology_panel <- function(in_df,
                               detector_choice,
                               element_choice,
                               y_element_col = "lambda_hat",
                               y_rec_col = "Recombination probability") {

  # Build lookup tables with `species` key
  gram_df <- enframe(gram) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(species = value, Gram = name)

  intestinal_df <- enframe(intestinal) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(species = value, Intestinal = name)
  
  # Identify nasopharyngeal pathogens
  np_df <-
    enframe(primary_niche) %>% 
      tidyr::unnest(value) %>%
      dplyr::rename(species = name) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(
        Nasopharynx =
          dplyr::case_when(
            species %in% c("Spn","Hflu","Msp") ~ "Nasopharyngeal",
            species %in% c("Sau","Nsp") ~ "Both",
            TRUE ~ "Non-nasopharyngeal"
          )
      ) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-value)

  # NOTE: your named vectors are key=name (code), value=label.
  # For joins by species binomial, invert appropriately:
  gram_df <- enframe(gram) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(code = name, Gram = unlist(value)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      enframe(species_name) %>% dplyr::rename(code = name, species = value),
      by = "code"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(species, Gram) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(species = unlist(species))

  intestinal_df <- enframe(intestinal) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(code = name, Intestinal = unlist(value)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      enframe(species_name) %>% dplyr::rename(code = name, species = value),
      by = "code"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(species, Intestinal) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(species = unlist(species))

  nasopharyngeal_df <-
    np_df %>% 
      dplyr::rename(code = species) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        enframe(species_name) %>% dplyr::rename(code = name, species = value),
        by = "code"
      ) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(species = unlist(species))
  
  plot_df <- in_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(detector == detector_choice, element_type == element_choice) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(gram_df, by = "species") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(intestinal_df, by = "species") %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(nasopharyngeal_df, by = "species") 

  element_label <- paste0(stringr::str_to_title(element_choice), "\nper isolate")

  rec_y_lab <- "Recombination\nprobability"
  
  rec_by_gram_plot <-
    plot_violin_kw(
      data = plot_df,
      x_var = Gram,
      y_var = .data[[y_rec_col]],
      x_lab = "Cell wall morphology",
      y_lab = rec_y_lab
    )

  element_by_gram_plot <-
    plot_violin_kw(
      data = plot_df,
      x_var = Gram,
      y_var = .data[[y_element_col]],
      x_lab = "Cell wall morphology",
      y_lab = element_label
    )

  rec_by_transformability_plot <-
    plot_violin_kw(
      data = plot_df,
      x_var = Transformability,
      y_var = .data[[y_rec_col]],
      x_lab = "Transformability",
      y_lab = rec_y_lab
    )

  element_by_transformability_plot <-
    plot_violin_kw(
      data = plot_df,
      x_var = Transformability,
      y_var = .data[[y_element_col]],
      x_lab = "Transformability",
      y_lab = element_label
    )

  rec_by_ecology_plot <-
    plot_violin_kw(
      data = plot_df,
      x_var = Intestinal,
      y_var = .data[[y_rec_col]],
      x_lab = "Association with intestinal tract",
      y_lab = rec_y_lab
    )

  element_by_ecology_plot <-
    plot_violin_kw(
      data = plot_df,
      x_var = Intestinal,
      y_var = .data[[y_element_col]],
      x_lab = "Association with intestinal tract",
      y_lab = element_label
    )

  rec_by_np_plot <-
    plot_violin_kw(
      data = plot_df %>% dplyr::filter(Nasopharynx!="Both"),
      x_var = Nasopharynx,
      y_var = .data[[y_rec_col]],
      x_lab = "Association with nasopharynx",
      y_lab = rec_y_lab
    )

  element_by_np_plot <-
    plot_violin_kw(
      data = plot_df %>% dplyr::filter(Nasopharynx!="Both"),
      x_var = Nasopharynx,
      y_var = .data[[y_element_col]],
      x_lab = "Association with nasopharynx",
      y_lab = element_label
    )
  
  composite_plots <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    plotlist = list(
      rec_by_transformability_plot + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none"),
      element_by_transformability_plot + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none"),
      rec_by_ecology_plot + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none"),
      element_by_ecology_plot + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none"),
      rec_by_np_plot + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none"),
      element_by_np_plot + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none"),
      rec_by_gram_plot + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none"),
      element_by_gram_plot + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
    ),
    nrow = 4, ncol = 2, labels = "AUTO"
  )

  comparison_legend <- cowplot::get_plot_component(
    element_by_ecology_plot +
      ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical") +
      ggplot2::guides(
        colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(title = "Transformability"),
        shape  = ggplot2::guide_legend(title = "Niche")
      ),
    "guide-box-bottom",
    return_all = TRUE
  )

  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    plotlist = list(composite_plots, comparison_legend),
    nrow = 2,
    rel_heights = c(0.90, 0.1)
  )

  list(plot = final_plot, data = plot_df)
}

process_replicates <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- stringr::str_to_lower(stringr::str_trim(as.character(x)))
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(x_chr, "^[0-9]+$") ~ x_chr,                               # "1" -> "1"
    stringr::str_detect(x_chr, "^[0-9]+(st|nd|rd|th)$") ~ 
      stringr::str_remove(x_chr, "(st|nd|rd|th)$"),                               # "1st" -> "1"
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}
```

# Analyse genotyping data

The species to be analysed are taken from those found to contribute to the burden of [antimicrobial resistant-disease](https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(21)02724-0), as these constitute a set of genetically-diverse and well-sampled bacteria:

- *Escherichia coli*: Multiple MLST schemes available for [*Escherichia* spp.](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_escherichia_seqdef); the Achtman scheme was used, as it had 7 loci.

- *Staphylococcus aureus*: One MLST database available for [*S. aureus*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_saureus_seqdef)

- *Klebsiella pneumoniae*: One MLST database available for [*K. pneumoniae*](https://bigsdb.pasteur.fr/cgi-bin/bigsdb/bigsdb.pl?db=pubmlst_klebsiella_seqdef)

- *Streptococcus pneumoniae*: One MLST database available for [*S. pneumoniae*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_spneumoniae_seqdef)

- *Acinetobacter baumannii*: One MLST database available for [*A. baumanii*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_abaumannii_seqdef)

- *Pseudomonas aeruginosa*: One MLST database available for [*P. aeruginosa*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_paeruginosa_seqdef)

- *Mycobacterium tuberculosis*: Excluded, as low diversity means MLST is not informative for this species.

- *Enterococcus faecium*: One MLST database available for [*E. faecium*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_efaecium_seqdef), although it is not clear whether other enterococci are effectively excluded, based on the species label in the profiles.

- *Enterobacter* spp.: One MLST database available for [*E. cloacae* and related species](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_ecloacae_seqdef).

- *Streptococcus agalactiae*: One MLST database available for [*S. agalactiae*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_sagalactiae_seqdef).

- *Salmonella spp.*: Dominated by *S. enterica*. One MLST database available for [*S. enterica*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_salmonella_seqdef).

- *Enterococcus faecalis*: One MLST database available for [*E. faecalis*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_efaecalis_seqdef).

- *Proteus* spp.: One MLST database for [*Proteus* species](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_proteus_seqdef).

- *Serratia* spp.: One MLST database for [*Serratia* species](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_serratia_seqdef).

- *Streptococcus pyogenes*: One MLST database available for [*S. pyogenes*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_spyogenes_seqdef).

- *Citrobacter* spp.: One MLST database available for [*C. freundii* and related species](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_cfreundii_seqdef).

- *Haemophilus influenzae*: One MLST database available for [*H. influenzae*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_hinfluenzae_seqdef).

- *Shigella* spp.: Excluded as not evolutionary independent from *E. coli*.

- *Morganella morganii*: One MLST database available for [*M. morganii*](https://bigsdb.pasteur.fr/cgi-bin/bigsdb/bigsdb.pl?db=pubmlst_morganella_seqdef).

These were supplemented with other species representing genera [known to be naturally transformable](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.resmic.2007.09.004):

- *Agrobacterium tumefaciens*:  Excluded, as no MLST data available.

- *Neisseria* spp.: One MLST database available for [*Neisseria* species](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_neisseria_seqdef); this can be included, as both *N. meningitidis* and *N. gonorrhoeae* are naturally transformable.

- *Legionella pneumophila*: Excluded, as no MLST data available from BigsDB.

- *Moraxella* spp.: One MLST database available for [*M. catarrhalis*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_moraxella_seqdef); this can be included, as *Moraxella* species are generally regarded as transformable.

- *Vibrio cholerae*: One MLST database available for [*V. cholerae*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_vcholerae_seqdef).

- *Campylobacter jejuni* & *coli*: One MLST database available for [*Campylobacter* spp.](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_campylobacter_seqdef). Both species are transformable, and therefore can be considered jointly.

- *Helicobacter pylori*: One MLST database available for [*H. pylori*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_helicobacter_seqdef).

- *Mycobacterium smegmatis*: Excluded as no MLST scheme available.

- *Bacillus subtilis*: One MLST database available for [*B. subtilis*](https://pubmlst.org/bigsdb?db=pubmlst_bsubtilis_seqdef).

Searches run on 4/12/25.

### Calculate MSTs from MLST data

```{r Calculate MST, eval = FALSE}

mlst_profiles <- list()
mlst_msts <- list()
slvs <- list()
mst_plots <- list()

for (name in rev(names(st_prefix))) {
  
  message(paste("Processing",name))
  
  mlst_profiles[[name]] <-
    read.table(paste0("./MLST_data/",st_prefix[[name]],".tab.txt"),
               sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("clonal_complex","species")))
  
  mlst_msts[[name]] <-
    generate_mst_from_mlst(mlst_profiles[[name]])
  
  slvs[[name]] <- as_data_frame(mlst_msts[[name]], what = "edges")
  
  mst_plots[[name]] <- plot_mst(mlst_msts[[name]])
  
  ggsave(paste0("./ebursts/",name,"_eburst.png"),
       mst_plots[[name]],
       width = 8,
       height = 8)
  
}

# Get summaries of MLST data
st_counts_df <-
  enframe(mlst_profiles) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(`Sequence types` =
                    map_int(value, nrow)) %>%  # count rows in each df
    dplyr::select(name, `Sequence types`) %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(enframe(species_name) %>% 
                       tidyr::unnest(value),
                     by = "name") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(name = value) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-value)

write_csv(
  st_counts_df,
  file = "./MLST_data/st_counts.csv"
)

```

### Calculate r/m statistics

``` {r Graph recombination}

rho_m_df <-
  mismatches_df %>% 
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(Classification)) %>% 
        dplyr::group_by(Species) %>% 
        dplyr::summarise(rho_m = sum(Classification=="Recombination")/sum(Classification=="Point mutation")) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup()

species_levels <-
  rho_m_df %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(rho_m) %>% 
    dplyr::pull(Species)

rho_m_df %<>%
  dplyr::mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_levels))

ggplot(rho_m_df,
        aes(x = Species,
            y = rho_m)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw()

```

### Fit generalised linear mixed effects model of homologous recombination

``` {r Model the probability of changes occurring through recombination, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}

rec_modelling_df <-
  mismatches_df %>% 
    dplyr::filter(!is_invalid) %>% 
    dplyr::select(Species,locus,Classification) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Locus = paste0(Species,"_",locus)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-locus) %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(Species) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(n_loci = n_distinct(Locus)) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(FPR = (1/n_loci)**2) %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(Species,Locus,FPR) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(Count = n(),
                     Rec_count = sum(Classification == "Recombination")) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(`Recombination proportion` = Rec_count/Count)

rec_probability_model <-
  glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
    `Recombination proportion` ~ Species + (1|Locus),
    data = rec_modelling_df,
    family = betabinomial(link = "logit"),
    ziformula = ~0,
    dispformula = ~1,
    weights = Count
  )

performance::check_model(rec_probability_model)

```

``` {r Plot probability of recombination, fig.width=8, fig.height = 8}

# Estimated marginal means per species on the response scale (probabilities)
rec_prob_df <-
  emmeans(
    rec_probability_model,
    specs  = ~ Species,
    type   = "response"  # back-transform from logit to probability
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

combined_rec_output_df <-
  rec_prob_df %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(rho_m_df, by = "Species")

ggplot(combined_rec_output_df,
       aes(x = rho_m,
           y = prob)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(aes(label = Species)) +
  theme_bw()

```

# Prophage data

## Search for complete genomes from target sequences

Searches run on 8/12/25. For multispecies datasets, the species were selected as the binomial names that were more common than the count of isolates within the genus with an undefined species name.

``` {bash, eval = FALSE}

cd prophage
conda activate edirect
for SPECIES in "Escherichia coli" "Staphylococcus aureus" "Klebsiella pneumoniae" "Streptococcus pneumoniae" "Acinetobacter baumanii"   "Pseudomonas aeruginosa" "Enterococcus faecium"    "Streptococcus agalactiae" "Salmonella enterica" "Enterococcus faecalis"    "Streptococcus pyogenes"   "Haemophilus influenzae" "Morganella morganii"      "Neisseria meningitidis" "Neisseria gonorrhoeae" "Moraxella catarrhalis" "Campylobacter jejuni"     "Helicobacter pylori"      "Vibrio cholerae" "Bacillus subtilis" "Serratia sarumanii" "Serratia ureilytica" "Serratia nevei" "Serratia nematodiphila" "Serratia bockelmannii" "Serratia liquefaciens" "Serratia fonticola" "Serratia marcescens" "Serratia plymuthica" "Proteus mirabilis" "Proteus terrae" "Enterobacter hormaechei" "Citrobacter freundii";
  do echo "Processing $SPECIES";
  SEARCH_STRING=`echo "\"$SPECIES\"[Organism] AND \"latest refseq\"[filter] AND complete_genome[filter] AND (all[filter] NOT anomalous[filter])"`
  esearch -db assembly -query "$SEARCH_STRING" | elink -target nuccore -name assembly_nuccore_refseq | esummary | xtract -pattern DocumentSummary -element AccessionVersion | sort -u > ${SPECIES}_nuccore_complete.txt;
  ./get_prophage_data.sh ${SPECIES}_nuccore_complete.txt ${SPECIES};
done
# Combine multispecies datasets
cat Neisseria\ gonorrhoeae_nuccore_complete.txt Neisseria\ meningitidis_nuccore_complete.txt > ./prophage/Neisseria\ spp_nuccore_complete.txt
cat Campylobacter\ coli_nuccore_complete.txt Campylobacter\ jejuni_nuccore_complete.txt > Campylobacter\ spp_nuccore_complete.txt
cat Serratia*_nuccore_complete.txt > Serratia\ spp_nuccore_complete.txt
cat Proteus*_nuccore_complete.txt > Proteus\ spp_nuccore_complete.txt
cat Enterobacter*_nuccore_complete.txt > Enterobacter\ spp_nuccore_complete.txt
cat Citrobacter*_nuccore_complete.txt > Citrobacter\ spp_nuccore_complete.txt

```

## Search for PHASTER results

``` {r Parse complete sequences}

phaster_df <-
  read_csv("./phaster_outputs/phaster_precomputed_accessions.csv")

complete_sequences_df <-
  map_dfr(species_name, ~ {
  # Create filename
  filename <- paste0("./prophage/",str_c(str_replace_all(.x, " ", "\\ "), "_nuccore_complete.txt"))
  # Read file if it exists
  if (file.exists(filename)) {
    read_tsv(filename, col_names = "data", col_types = "c") %>%
      mutate(species =.x)
  } else {
    tibble(data = character(0), species =.x)
  }
}) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(
      # Include only complete genomes (shorter accession numbers)
      str_detect(data, "^[A-Z]{2}\\d{4,8}\\.\\d+$")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Extract components from data column
    accession_base = str_extract(data, "^[A-Z]{2}\\d+"),
    full_accession = data
  )

phaster_complete_sequences_df <-
  complete_sequences_df %>% 
    # Try exact match first
    dplyr::left_join(
      phaster_df %>%
        dplyr::select(accession, submission_url:summary_url),
      by = c("full_accession" = "accession")
    ) %>%
    # For unmatched, try base accession match
    dplyr::left_join(
      phaster_df %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(accession_base = str_extract(accession, "^[A-Z]{2}\\d+")) %>%
        dplyr::select(accession_base, accession, submission_url:summary_url) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(accession_base,.keep_all = TRUE),
      by = "accession_base",
      suffix = c("", "_base")
    ) %>%
    # Coalesce to prioritize exact matches
    dplyr::mutate(
      matched_accession = coalesce(accession, accession_base),
      final_submission_url = coalesce(submission_url, submission_url_base),
      final_zip_url = coalesce(zip_url, zip_url_base),
      final_summary_url = coalesce(summary_url, summary_url_base)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      data, 
      species, 
      matched_accession,
      submission_url = final_submission_url,
      zip_url = final_zip_url,
      summary_url = final_summary_url
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(submission_url))

# Export your accessions to a text file
write.csv(
  phaster_complete_sequences_df %>%
    dplyr::pull(data),
    file = "prophage/phaster_accessions.txt",
    quote = F,
    row.names = F,
    col.names = FALSE)

```

``` {r Processing phaster summary.txt, eval = FALSE}

parse_phaster_summary <- function(file, accession) {
  # If file missing or empty, return nothing
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
  lines <- readr::read_lines(file)
  if (length(lines) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Find header line
  header_idx <- which(str_detect(lines, "^\\s*REGION\\s+REGION_LENGTH"))
  if (length(header_idx) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Find dashed separator after header
  sep_idx <- header_idx + 1
  while (sep_idx <= length(lines) && !str_detect(lines[sep_idx], "-{5,}")) {
    sep_idx <- sep_idx + 1
  }
  if (sep_idx > length(lines)) return(NULL)

  data_start <- sep_idx + 1

  # Data lines
  data_lines <- lines[data_start:length(lines)]
  data_lines <- data_lines[data_lines != ""]
  if (length(data_lines) == 0) return(NULL)

  # --- line parser using whitespace ---
  parse_line <- function(x) {
    parts <- x %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_split("\\s+", simplify = TRUE) %>%
      as.character()

    if (length(parts) < 16) return(NULL)

    region        <- parts[1]
    region_length <- parts[2]
    completeness  <- parts[3]

    rest <- parts[-(1:3)]
    if (length(rest) == 0) return(NULL)

    # REGION_POSITION looks like "start-end"
    pos_idx <- which(str_detect(rest, "^[0-9]+-[0-9]+$"))[1]
    if (is.na(pos_idx)) return(NULL)

    # SPECIFIC_KEYWORD = everything before REGION_POSITION
    specific_keyword <-
      if (pos_idx == 1) NA_character_
      else paste(rest[1:(pos_idx - 1)], collapse = " ")

    tail_tokens <- rest[pos_idx:length(rest)]
    if (length(tail_tokens) < 13) return(NULL)

    tibble(
      REGION                    = region,
      REGION_LENGTH             = region_length,
      COMPLETENESS_SCORE        = completeness,
      SPECIFIC_KEYWORD          = specific_keyword,
      REGION_POSITION           = tail_tokens[1],
      TRNA_NUM                  = tail_tokens[2],
      TOTAL_PROTEIN_NUM         = tail_tokens[3],
      PHAGE_HIT_PROTEIN_NUM     = tail_tokens[4],
      HYPOTHETICAL_PROTEIN_NUM  = tail_tokens[5],
      PHAGE_HYPO_PERCENT        = tail_tokens[6],
      BACTERIAL_PROTEIN_NUM     = tail_tokens[7],
      ATT_SITE_SHOWUP           = tail_tokens[8],
      PHAGE_SPECIES_NUM         = tail_tokens[9],
      MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_NAME    = tail_tokens[10],
      MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_NUM     = tail_tokens[11],
      MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_PERCENT = tail_tokens[12],
      GC_PERCENTAGE             = tail_tokens[13]
    )
  }

  df <- map_dfr(data_lines, parse_line)
  if (!("REGION" %in% names(df)) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  # ---------- clean types, keep all regions ----------
  clean_df <- df %>%
    filter(str_detect(REGION, "^\\d+$")) %>%
    mutate(
      REGION              = as.integer(REGION),
      REGION_LENGTH_Kb    = as.numeric(str_remove(REGION_LENGTH, "Kb")),
      COMPLETENESS        = str_extract(COMPLETENESS_SCORE, "^[^()]+") %>% str_trim(),
      SCORE               = str_extract(COMPLETENESS_SCORE, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\))") %>% as.integer(),
      TOTAL_PROTEIN_NUM   = as.integer(TOTAL_PROTEIN_NUM),
      TRNA_NUM            = as.integer(TRNA_NUM),
      PHAGE_HIT_PROTEIN_NUM    = as.integer(PHAGE_HIT_PROTEIN_NUM),
      HYPOTHETICAL_PROTEIN_NUM = as.integer(HYPOTHETICAL_PROTEIN_NUM),
      PHAGE_HYPO_PERCENT       = as.numeric(str_remove(PHAGE_HYPO_PERCENT, "%")),
      BACTERIAL_PROTEIN_NUM    = as.integer(BACTERIAL_PROTEIN_NUM),
      PHAGE_SPECIES_NUM        = as.integer(PHAGE_SPECIES_NUM),
      MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_NUM    = as.integer(MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_NUM),
      MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_PERCENT = as.numeric(str_remove(MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_PERCENT, "%")),
      GC_PERCENTAGE            = as.numeric(str_remove(GC_PERCENTAGE, "%"))
    )

  if (nrow(clean_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  # ---------- keywords → long ----------
  keywords_long <- clean_df %>%
    mutate(SPECIFIC_KEYWORD = coalesce(SPECIFIC_KEYWORD, "")) %>%
    separate_rows(SPECIFIC_KEYWORD, sep = ",") %>%
    mutate(
      SPECIFIC_KEYWORD = str_trim(SPECIFIC_KEYWORD),
      SPECIFIC_KEYWORD = na_if(SPECIFIC_KEYWORD, "")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(SPECIFIC_KEYWORD))

  # No keywords at all in this file: return regions without keyword columns
  if (nrow(keywords_long) == 0) {
    out <- clean_df %>%
      transmute(
        accession,
        REGION,
        REGION_LENGTH_Kb,
        TOTAL_PROTEIN_NUM,
        PHAGE_HIT_PROTEIN_NUM,
        COMPLETENESS,
        SCORE,
        MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_NAME
      )
    return(out)
  }

  # ---------- keywords → wide, values_fill = 0 ----------
  keyword_matrix <- keywords_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value = 1L) %>%
    dplyr::select(REGION, SPECIFIC_KEYWORD, value) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from  = SPECIFIC_KEYWORD,
      values_from = value,
      values_fill = 0   # ensures missing combos get 0
    )

  # ---------- final output ----------
  final_df <- clean_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      REGION,
      REGION_LENGTH_Kb,
      TOTAL_PROTEIN_NUM,
      PHAGE_HIT_PROTEIN_NUM,
      COMPLETENESS,
      SCORE,
      MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_NAME
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(keyword_matrix, by = "REGION") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(accession = accession,.before = 1)

  # Ensure *all* keyword columns are 0/1 with no NA
  # (i.e. any NA left from the join are turned into 0)
  non_keyword_cols <- c(
    "accession",
    "REGION",
    "REGION_LENGTH_Kb",
    "TOTAL_PROTEIN_NUM",
    "PHAGE_HIT_PROTEIN_NUM",
    "COMPLETENESS",
    "SCORE",
    "MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_NAME"
  )

  keyword_cols <- setdiff(names(final_df), non_keyword_cols)

  if (length(keyword_cols) > 0) {
    final_df <- final_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(across(all_of(keyword_cols),
                    ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0)))
  }

  final_df
}

all_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  filtered_genome_df$Accession,
  ~parse_phaster_summary(
    file      = paste0("./phaster_outputs/",.x, ".txt"),
    accession =.x
  )
) %>%
  { 
    non_keyword_cols <- c(
      "accession",
      "REGION",
      "REGION_LENGTH_Kb",
      "TOTAL_PROTEIN_NUM",
      "PHAGE_HIT_PROTEIN_NUM",
      "COMPLETENESS",
      "SCORE",
      "MOST_COMMON_PHAGE_NAME"
    )
    keyword_cols <- setdiff(names(.), non_keyword_cols)

    dplyr::mutate(.,
      across(
        all_of(keyword_cols),
        ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0)
      )
    )
  }

# Store summarised results for more efficient reanalysis
write_csv(all_results,
          file = "./phaster_outputs/phaster_analysis_summary.csv"
          )
```

``` {r Count prophage per genome, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 8}
# Filter prophage and count per genome

  all_results %>% 
    dplyr::filter(PHAGE_HIT_PROTEIN_NUM >= lower_gene_bound & PHAGE_HIT_PROTEIN_NUM <= upper_gene_bound & COMPLETENESS == "intact") %>%

# Combine phage counts with species information
filtered_prophage_per_sample_df <-
  filtered_genome_df %>% 
    # Set consistent name
    dplyr::group_by(BioSampleAccession) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Name = dplyr::if_else(SequenceLength==max(SequenceLength),BioSampleName,NA_character_)) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Name, .direction = "updown") %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    # Process prophage data
    dplyr::left_join(filtered_prophage_count_df, by = c("Accession" = "accession")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(phage_count = dplyr::if_else(is.na(phage_count),0,phage_count)) %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(BioSampleAccession,Name,species) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(total_phage_count = sum(phage_count)) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(species) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      total_obs = n()

    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(species,total_phage_count) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      obs_prob = n()/total_obs

    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(
      enframe(species_name) %>% 
        tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
        dplyr::rename(species = value),
      by = "species"
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(
      enframe(display_name) %>% 
        tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
        dplyr::rename(display = value),
      by = "name"
```

## Identify genomes for geNomad analysis

Taking the same set of complete genome accession codes, we first obtain the lengths of the complete genomes identified from the NCBI search above:

``` {bash, eval = FALSE}

for f in */*txt; do DIRNAME=`dirname $f`; BASENAME=`basename $f`; cd $DIRNAME; bsub -M 1000 -R 'select[mem>1000] rusage[mem=1000]' -o download_metadata.o -e download_metadata.e ../download_nuccore_metadata.sh $BASENAME ${BASENAME%txt}accessions; cd ..; done

```

We select up to 200 Biosample IDs for each species in which the replicons' total length matches that expected for a genome:

``` {r Find biosamples of suitable size, eval = FALSE}

set.seed(42)

# Read all .accessions files into a single dataframe
complete_accessions_df <-
  # Gather information on accessions
  list.files(
    path       = "./genomad_analysis/genome_accessions",
    pattern    = "\\.accessions$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ) |>
  set_names() |>
  map(read_tsv, 
      col_names     = TRUE, 
      col_types     = cols(.default = col_character()),   # read ALL cols as character
      show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "filepath") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    species = str_extract(filepath, "([^/]+)(?=_nuccore_complete\\.accessions$)")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(species, everything(), -filepath) %>% 
  # Get rid of duplicates
  dplyr::group_by(resolved_accession) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(accession_count = n()) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(accession_count == 1) %>% 
  # Now check on total length
  dplyr::inner_join(read.table("./genomad_analysis/genome_accessions/complete_replicon_lengths.tsv",
                               header = TRUE),
                    by = c("resolved_accession")) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(biosample) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Total_length = sum(length)) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  # Filter by total length
    dplyr::left_join(
      enframe(lower_length_threshold) %>%
            tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
            dplyr::rename(Lower = value) %>% 
        dplyr::left_join(
        enframe(upper_length_threshold) %>%
            tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
            dplyr::rename(Upper = value)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(enframe(species_name) %>%
                           tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
                           dplyr::rename(species = value),
                             by = "name") %>%
        dplyr::left_join(enframe(display_name) %>%
                           tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
                           dplyr::rename(display = value),
                             by = "name") %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(species = gsub(" ","_",species)),
        by = "species"
      ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Total_length > Lower & Total_length < Upper) |>
  # Mark selected biosamples
  # Step 1: Sample up to 200 unique biosamples per species
  dplyr::group_by(species) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    selected_biosample = biosample %in% sample(
      unique(biosample), 
      size = min(200, n_distinct(biosample))  # take all if fewer than 200
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  # Step 2: Mark all resolved_accessions belonging to selected biosamples
  dplyr::mutate(
    selected_biosample = dplyr::if_else(selected_biosample, "Selected", "Unselected")
  ) %>% 
  # Step 3: Flag WGS shotgun accessions (e.g. QWKQ00000000.2)
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_wgs = str_detect(
      resolved_accession,
      "^[A-Z]{4,8}\\d*0{4,}(\\.\\d+)?$"   # 4-6 letters, digits ending in 4+ zeros, optional version
    )
  ) |>
  # Step 4: Flag biosample as WGS if ANY of its accessions are WGS
  dplyr::group_by(species, biosample) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    wgs_biosample = any(is_wgs)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  # Step 5: Unselect WGS biosamples that were selected
  dplyr::mutate(
    selected_biosample = dplyr::if_else(
      wgs_biosample & selected_biosample == "Selected",
      "Unselected",
      selected_biosample
    )
  ) |>
  # Step 6: For each species, top up from non-WGS unselected biosamples
  dplyr::group_by(species) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    selected_biosample = {
      # How many selected biosamples do we currently have?
      n_currently_selected <- n_distinct(biosample[selected_biosample == "Selected"])

      # How many do we need to top up?
      n_needed <- max(0, 200 - n_currently_selected)

      # Pool of unselected, non-WGS biosamples to draw replacements from
      replacement_pool <- unique(biosample[
        selected_biosample == "Unselected" & !wgs_biosample
      ])

      # Sample replacements (up to n_needed, or all available if fewer)
      replacements <- if (length(replacement_pool) > 0 && n_needed > 0) {
        sample(replacement_pool, size = min(n_needed, length(replacement_pool)))
      } else {
        character(0)
      }

      # Mark ALL accessions in replacement biosamples as Selected
      dplyr::if_else(
        biosample %in% replacements,
        "Selected",
        selected_biosample
      )
    }
  ) |>
  # Step 7: Propagate selection to ALL accessions in each selected biosample
  dplyr::group_by(species, biosample) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    selected_biosample = dplyr::if_else(
      any(selected_biosample == "Selected"),
      "Selected",
      "Unselected"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Write output to enable selection
write.csv(complete_accessions_df %>% 
            dplyr::filter(selected_biosample == "Selected") %>% 
            dplyr::mutate(Path = paste0(species,"/fasta/",resolved_accession,".fasta")) %>% 
            dplyr::pull(Path),
          file = "./genomad_analysis/accession_code_selection.csv",
          quote = FALSE,
          col.names = FALSE,
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(complete_accessions_df,
          file = gzfile("./genomad_analysis/accession_code_info.csv.gz"),
          quote = TRUE,
          col.names = FALSE,
          row.names = FALSE)

```

### Identify thresholds for geNomad analysis

Identify prophage densities in species:

``` {r Prophage counts from geNomad}

# Threshold for identifying funtional phage
genomad_Caudoviricetes_threshold <- 9
genomad_Inoviridae_threshold <- 3

# Process geNomad prophage output
genomad_phage_df <-
  genomad_results_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Classification =
                   dplyr::case_when(
                     is.na(length) ~ NA_character_,
                     grepl("Caudoviricetes",taxonomy) ~ "Caudoviricetes",
                     grepl("Inoviridae",taxonomy) ~ "Inoviridae",
                     grepl("Vinavirales",taxonomy) ~ "Vinavirales",
                     TRUE ~ "Other"
                   )
                ) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(
    read.table("./genomad_analysis/genomad_virus_amidase_lysozyme_counts.tsv",
               header = TRUE) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-accession),
    by = "seq_name"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Amidase = dplyr::if_else(total_count > 0,"Lytic amidase genes present","No lytic amidase gene detected")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Threshold =
                  dplyr::case_when(
                    Classification == "Caudoviricetes" ~ genomad_Caudoviricetes_threshold,
                    Classification == "Inoviridae" ~ genomad_Inoviridae_threshold,
                    TRUE ~ NA_integer_
                  )
                )

# Plot functional information
ggplot(genomad_phage_df %>% 
         dplyr::filter(!is.na(length)),
       aes(x = n_hallmarks)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "blue") +
  facet_grid(Amidase~Classification) +
  geom_vline(data = . %>% dplyr::select(Classification,Threshold) %>% dplyr::distinct(),
             aes(xintercept = Threshold), colour = "red", linetype = 2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  xlab("Number of hallmark prophage proteins") +
  ylab("Count") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

```

### Distribution of prophage per species

``` {r Plot distribution by species, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8}

# Define the classification universe once
all_classifications <- genomad_phage_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Classification)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Classification)

# Per-accession counts from geNomad
genomad_counts_by_accession_class_df <-
  genomad_phage_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phage_detected = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(length) & !is.na(Threshold) &
        n_hallmarks > Threshold &
        topology == "Provirus",
      1L, 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(no_version_accession), !is.na(Classification)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(no_version_accession, Classification) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(phage_count = sum(phage_detected), .groups = "drop")

genomad_phage_by_species_df <-
  complete_accessions_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(selected_biosample == "Selected") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("000000", no_version_accession)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(no_version_accession, biosample, species, display, Total_length) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(all_classifications) %>%   # ensures every accession has every Classification
  dplyr::left_join(
    genomad_counts_by_accession_class_df,
    by = c("no_version_accession", "Classification")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(phage_count = tidyr::replace_na(phage_count, 0L)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(biosample, species, display, Classification) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_phage_count = sum(phage_count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(species = gsub("_", " ", species))

# Plot fitted distributions against observed prophage counts
ggplot() +
  # Observed probabilities as bars
  geom_bar(
    data = genomad_phage_by_species_df,
    aes(x = total_phage_count, fill = Classification),

    width = 0.8,
    position = position_dodge(preserve = "single")

  facet_wrap(~display,
             scales = "free_y",

  labs(
    x = "Total phage count per sample",
    y = "Proportion"

  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Analyse distributions across elements

First, combine all the mobile element dataframes:

``` {r Combine mobile elements and fit Poisson model}

# PHASTER phage
phaster_phage_counts_long <-
  filtered_prophage_per_sample_df %>% 
    dplyr::transmute(
    biosample = BioSampleAccession,
    species,
    display,
    element_type = "prophage",
    count = as.integer(total_phage_count),
    detector = "PHASTER"
  )

# geNomad phage
genomad_phage_counts_long <-
  genomad_phage_by_species_df %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    biosample,
    species,
    display,
    element_type = Classification,
    count = as.integer(total_phage_count),
    detector = "geNomad"
  )

# geNomad plasmid
genomad_plasmid_counts_long <-
  genomad_plasmid_by_species_df %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    biosample,
    species,
    display,
    element_type = Classification,
    count = as.integer(total_plasmid_count),
    detector = "geNomad"
  )

# Combine
mobile_counts_long <-
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    genomad_phage_counts_long,
    phaster_phage_counts_long,
    genomad_plasmid_counts_long
  )

poisson_summary_df <-
  fit_poisson_by_species(mobile_counts_long)

```

Poisson fit to prophage from PHASTER:

``` {r Poisson fits to PHASTER data, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8}

plot_observed_vs_poisson(
  observed_data = mobile_counts_long,
  poisson_summary_data = poisson_summary_df,
  detector_value = "PHASTER",
  element_type_value = "prophage",
  x_label = "PHASTER prophage count per sample"
)$plot

```


Two groups of bacteria exhibited a substantial deviation from the unimodal distribution expected of a homogeneously-behaving population:

- *Enterobacter* spp.: there are many isolates (of both *E. hormaechei* and *E. cloacae*) that lack any prophage, despite a peak at 4 prophage per isolate (isolates of *E. hormaechei*)

- *Proteus* spp.: there are many isolates (of both *P. mirabilis* and *P. terrae*) that lack any prophage, despite a peak at 2 prophage per isolate (isolates of *P. mirabilis* and *P. terrae*)

These were excluded from the subsequent comparison, to ensure the MLST and prophage data both corresponded to homogeneously behaving populations of isolates.

# Compare prophage density and recombination rate

Model the relationship between the density of prophage in genomes and rates of core genome recombination:

``` {r Compare prophage density with recombination rate, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 8}

# Excluded species
excluded_species <- c("Esp","Psp")

# Combine prophage density with homologous recombination
prophage_rec_df <-
  poisson_summary_df %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(
    rec_prob_df %>% 
      dplyr::rename(`Recombination probability` = prob) %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(tibble::enframe(species_name) %>%
                         tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
                         dplyr::rename(
                           Species = name,
                           species_name = value
                         ),
                       by = "Species") %>% 
      dplyr::left_join(tibble::enframe(display_name) %>%
                         tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
                         dplyr::rename(
                           Species = name,
                           display_name = value
                         ),
                       by = "Species") %>% 
      # Add transformable status
      dplyr::left_join(enframe(transformable) %>%
                        tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
                        dplyr::rename(Transformability = value),
                       by = c("Species" = "name")) %>% 
      # Add ecological status
      dplyr::left_join(enframe(primary_niche) %>%
                        tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
                        dplyr::rename(Niche = value),
                       by = c("Species" = "name")),
    by = c("species"="species_name")
  ) %>% 
  # Remove poor Poisson fits
  dplyr::filter(!(Species %in% excluded_species & detector == "PHASTER"))

```

# Formal test of ecology

Here we formally test the associations between transformability, ecology, recombination and prophage counts:

## Write out ecological information to table

``` {r Ecological information table}

ecological_df <-
  enframe(primary_niche) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(value = unlist(value)) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(Niche = value) %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(enframe(display_name) %>% 
                       dplyr::mutate(Species = unlist(value)) %>% 
                       dplyr::select(-value),
                     by= c("name")
                     ) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Comment = 
                    dplyr::case_when(
                      name == "Sau" ~ "Found in nares, skin and gastrointestinal tract",
                      name == "Sag" ~ "Found in gastrointestinal and genital tracts",
                      name == "Nsp" ~ "Meningococci found in nasopharynx; gonococci found in the genital tract",
                      name == "Hpy" ~ "Found in stomach",
                      name == "Spy" ~ "Found in throat",
                      name %in% c("Spn","Hflu","Mcat") ~ "Found in nasopharynx",
                      TRUE ~ ""
                    )
                  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-name)

clean_species <- function(x) {
  y <- x

  # case 1: italic('...')~'spp.'
  y <- str_replace(
    y,
    "^italic\\('([^']+)'\\)~'spp\\.'$",
    "<i>\\1</i> spp."
  )

  # case 2: italic('...')
  y <- str_replace(
    y,
    "^italic\\('([^']+)'\\)$",
    "<i>\\1</i>"
  )

  y
}

ecological_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Species = clean_species(Species)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species,Niche,Comment) %>% 
  knitr::kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%   # important
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

``` {r Tabulate number of samples per species}
        ) %>%

    ) %>%

    dplyr::select(Species,`Sequence types`,`Divergent genotypes`,`Complete replicons`,`PHASTER entries`,`Full-length genomes analysed with PHASTER`) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(
    genomad_phage_by_species_df %>% 
      dplyr::group_by(biosample) %>% 
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
      dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
      dplyr::group_by(species) %>% 
      dplyr::summarise(`Full-length genomes analysed with geNomad` = n()) %>% 
      dplyr::ungroup(),
    by = c("Species"="species")
  )

# Full length genomes used for geNomad
# Read all .accessions files into a single dataframe
full_length_genomes_df <-
  # Gather information on accessions
  list.files(
    path       = "./genomad_analysis/genome_accessions",
    pattern    = "\\.accessions$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ) |>
  set_names() |>
  map(read_tsv, 
      col_names     = TRUE, 
      col_types     = cols(.default = col_character()),   # read ALL cols as character
      show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "filepath") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    species = str_extract(filepath, "([^/]+)(?=_nuccore_complete\\.accessions$)")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(species, everything(), -filepath) %>% 
  # Get rid of duplicates
  dplyr::group_by(resolved_accession) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(accession_count = n()) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(accession_count == 1) %>% 
  # Now check on total length
  dplyr::inner_join(read.table("./genomad_analysis/genome_accessions/complete_replicon_lengths.tsv",
                               header = TRUE),
                    by = c("resolved_accession")) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(biosample) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Total_length = sum(length)) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  # Filter by total length
    dplyr::left_join(
      enframe(lower_length_threshold) %>%
            tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
            dplyr::rename(Lower = value) %>% 
        dplyr::left_join(
        enframe(upper_length_threshold) %>%
            tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
            dplyr::rename(Upper = value)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(enframe(species_name) %>%
                           tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
                           dplyr::rename(species = value),
                             by = "name") %>%
        dplyr::left_join(enframe(display_name) %>%
                           tidyr::unnest(value) %>% 
                           dplyr::rename(display = value),
                             by = "name") %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(species = gsub(" ","_",species)),
        by = "species"
      ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Total_length > Lower & Total_length < Upper) %>% 
  # Step 3: Flag WGS shotgun accessions (e.g. QWKQ00000000.2)
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_wgs = str_detect(
      resolved_accession,
      "^[A-Z]{4,8}\\d*0{4,}(\\.\\d+)?$"   # 4-6 letters, digits ending in 4+ zeros, optional version
    )
  ) |>
  # Step 4: Flag biosample as WGS if ANY of its accessions are WGS
  dplyr::group_by(species, biosample) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    wgs_biosample = any(is_wgs)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::filter(!wgs_biosample) |>         #
  # Final
  dplyr::group_by(species) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(`Full length genomes` = n_distinct(biosample)) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Generate summary table
sample_summary_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(full_length_genomes_df %>% dplyr::mutate(Species = gsub("_"," ",species)) %>% dplyr::select(-species), by = "Species") %>% 
  dplyr::select(Species,`Sequence types`,`Divergent genotypes`,`Complete replicons`,`Full length genomes`,`Full-length genomes analysed with geNomad`,`PHASTER entries`,`Full-length genomes analysed with PHASTER`) %>% 
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

```
