# Experimental data

## Analyse qPCR data

### Parse qPCR data

``` {r Process qPCR data}

competence_palette <- c(
  "Spontaneous competence" = "darkolivegreen3",
  "Induced competence" = "seagreen3",
  "Control" = "grey"
)

qpcr_df <-
  read_csv("./experimental_data/complete_qPCR_data.csv") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(`Experimental conditions` =
                    dplyr::case_when(
                      mutants == "NO_CSP" ~ "Control",
                      mutants == "CSP_DnaseI" ~ "Control",
                      mutants == "CSP" ~ "Control",
                      grepl("_CSP",mutants) ~ "Induced competence",
                      TRUE ~ "Spontaneous competence"
                    )
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(DNA =
                    dplyr::case_when(
                      mutants == "NO_CSP" ~ "No CSP or DNA",
                      mutants == "CSP_DnaseI" ~ "CSP and DNase",
                      mutants == "CSP" ~ "CSP, no DNA",
                      grepl("E99",mutants) ~ "1% pneumococcal",
                      grepl("E90",mutants) ~ "10% pneumococcal",
                      grepl("E50",mutants) ~ "50% pneumococcal",
                      grepl("E10",mutants) ~ "90% pneumococcal",
                      grepl("E1",mutants) ~ "99% pneumococcal"
                    )
    ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Timepoint = 
      dplyr::case_when(
        conditions == "2hour" ~ "'2h post-subculture'",
        conditions == "4hour" ~ "'4h post-subculture'"
      )
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Phage_circular,PRCI_circular),
                      names_to = "MGE",
                      values_to = "qPCR") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    RMV8_MGE = 
      factor(
        dplyr::case_when(
          MGE == "Phage_circular" ~ "phi*'RMV8'",
          MGE == "PRCI_circular" ~ "'PRCI'[italic(malA)]"
        ),
        levels = c("phi*'RMV8'","'PRCI'[italic(malA)]")
      )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(qPCR)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(`Biological replicate` = process_replicates(Replicate)) %>% 
  # Adjust for 1.25 ul sampled volume
  dplyr::mutate(qPCR = qPCR/1.25) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DNA = factor(DNA,
                             levels = c("1% pneumococcal", "10% pneumococcal", "50% pneumococcal", "90% pneumococcal", "99% pneumococcal",
                                        "No CSP or DNA", "CSP and DNase", "CSP, no DNA")
                             )
                ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Locus = "attP") %>% 
  # Remove replicate with mislabelled CSP that contains rpoA measurements
  dplyr::group_by(`Experimental conditions`,DNA,Timepoint,MGE,`Biological replicate`) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(.idx = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(`Experimental conditions`,DNA,Timepoint,MGE,.idx) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(`Biological replicate`, .by_group = TRUE) %>% 
  tidyr::fill(rpoA, .direction = "down") %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-.idx) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(`Biological replicate` != "3") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(`Biological replicate` = dplyr::if_else(
    `Biological replicate` == "4",
    "3",
    `Biological replicate`)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(`Biological replicate` = factor(`Biological replicate`))

```

### Calculate significance of differences between qPCR data

``` {r Test for significance for qPCR data}

# Keep only DNA percentage conditions of interest
dna_levels <- c("1% pneumococcal", "10% pneumococcal", "50% pneumococcal",
                "90% pneumococcal", "99% pneumococcal")

qpcr_signif_test <- function(in_df, dna_levels) {
  model_df <- in_df %>% 
    dplyr::filter(`Experimental conditions` != "Control") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
      DNA = factor(DNA, levels = dna_levels),
      RMV8_MGE = factor(RMV8_MGE),
      Timepoint = factor(Timepoint),
      `Experimental conditions` = factor(`Experimental conditions`),
      log_qPCR = log10(qPCR)
    )

  nested <- model_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RMV8_MGE, Timepoint, `Experimental conditions`) %>%
    tidyr::nest()

  fit_one <- function(dat) {
    dat <- droplevels(dat)
    if (dplyr::n_distinct(dat$DNA) < 2) return(NULL)

    glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      log_qPCR ~ DNA + (1 | `Biological replicate`),
      data = dat,
      family = gaussian(),
      ziformula = ~0
    )
  }

  nested <- nested %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fit = purrr::map(data, fit_one),
      emm = purrr::map(fit, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NULL else emmeans::emmeans(.x, ~ DNA)),
      ctr = purrr::map(emm, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NULL else emmeans::contrast(.x, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1)),
      ctr_tbl = purrr::map(ctr, ~ if (is.null(.x)) tibble::tibble() else tibble::as_tibble(summary(.x, infer = TRUE)))
    )

  contrast_df <- nested %>%
    dplyr::select(RMV8_MGE, Timepoint, `Experimental conditions`, ctr_tbl) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(ctr_tbl) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(DNA_comp = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "^[^-]+") %>% stringr::str_trim()) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RMV8_MGE, Timepoint, `Experimental conditions`) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm")) %>%
    rstatix::add_significance(p.col = "p.adj") %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  mge_annot_df <- model_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RMV8_MGE, Timepoint, `Experimental conditions`, DNA) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(ymax = max(qPCR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      contrast_df %>%
        dplyr::rename(DNA = DNA_comp) %>%
        dplyr::select(RMV8_MGE, Timepoint, `Experimental conditions`, DNA, p.adj, p.adj.signif),
      by = c("RMV8_MGE", "Timepoint", "Experimental conditions", "DNA")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(DNA), p.adj < 0.1) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      y = dplyr::if_else(
        `Experimental conditions` == "Induced competence",
        max(in_df$qPCR, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.4,
        max(in_df$qPCR, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) * 1.25,
      DNA = factor(DNA, levels = dna_levels)
    )

}

mge_annot_df <- qpcr_signif_test(qpcr_df, dna_levels)

```

### Plot qPCR data

``` {r Plot qPCR data, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}

(qpcr_plot <-
  ggplot(qpcr_df,
         aes(x = DNA,
             y = qPCR,
             colour = `Experimental conditions`,
             fill = `Experimental conditions`,
             group = interaction(DNA,`Experimental conditions`),
             shape = `Biological replicate`)) +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.5),
                position = position_dodge(preserve = "single"),
                scale = "width",
                alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge()) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = competence_palette,
                        aesthetics = c("fill","colour")) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
    ylab(expression(atop(italic(attP)~'sites per'~mu*'l','culture supernatant'))) +
    facet_grid(RMV8_MGE~Timepoint,
               labeller = label_parsed) +
    xlab("Experimental conditions") +
    geom_text(
      data = mge_annot_df %>% dplyr::mutate(qPCR = y, `Biological replicate` = "1"),
      #aes(label = paste0("italic(p)==", signif(p.adj, 2))),

    ) +

)
```

### Contrasts of 1% and 99% pneumococcal DNA experiments

``` {r Focus on change in spontaneous deletion}

rmv8_decline_df <-
  dplyr::bind_rows(
     qpcr_df %>%

        `Experimental conditions` == "Spontaneous competence" &

        conditions == "4hour" &

      ),
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      read_csv("./experimental_data/additional_qPCR_data.csv"),
      read_csv("./experimental_data/Spontaneous_extra_replicates.csv")
    ) %>% 
      dplyr::filter(conditions=="4hour") %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(`Experimental conditions` = "Spontaneous competence") %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(DNA =

                      )
      ) %>% 
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Phage_circular,PRCI_circular),
                          names_to = "MGE",
                          values_to = "qPCR") %>% 
      dplyr::filter(MGE == "Phage_circular") %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(`Biological replicate` = process_replicates(Replicate)),
    read_csv("./experimental_data/extra_replicate_spontaneous_qPCR.csv") %>% 
      dplyr::filter(conditions=="4hour") %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(DNA =
                      dplyr::case_when(
                        grepl("E99",mutants) ~ "1% pneumococcal",
                        grepl("E1",mutants) ~ "99% pneumococcal"
                      )
      ) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(`Experimental conditions` = "Spontaneous competence") %>% 
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = c(Phage_circular,PRCI_circular),
        names_to = "MGE",
        values_to = "qPCR") %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(`Biological replicate` = process_replicates(Replicate)) %>% 
        dplyr::filter(MGE == "Phage_circular")
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(RMV8_MGE = "phi*'RMV8'",
                  Timepoint = '4h post-subculture')

test_res_df <-
  qpcr_signif_test(rmv8_decline_df, c("1% pneumococcal","99% pneumococcal"))

spontaneous_start_end_df <-
  rmv8_decline_df %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(DNA,`Biological replicate`,`Experimental conditions`) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Mean_est = mean(qPCR)) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(DNA) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Baseline =
                    dplyr::if_else(
                      DNA == "1% pneumococcal",
                      Mean_est,
                      NA_real_
                    )
                  ) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(`Biological replicate`,`Experimental conditions`) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Baseline, .direction = "updown") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Change = qPCR/Baseline) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::filter(DNA == "99% pneumococcal")

# Plot fold changes
replicate_palette <- c(16,17,15,3,7,5,10)
names(replicate_palette) = as.character(1:7)

fmt_p_plotmath <- function(p, digits = 2) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("italic(p)==NA")
  e <- floor(log10(p))
  m <- signif(p / (10^e), digits)
  paste0("italic(p)==", m, "%*%10^", e)
}

(fold_change_plot <-
  ggplot(spontaneous_start_end_df,
         aes(x = `Biological replicate`,
             shape = `Biological replicate`,
             colour = `Experimental conditions`,
             fill = `Experimental conditions`,
             y = Change)) +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.5),
                scale = "width",
                alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15)) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = replicate_palette) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = competence_palette,
                        aesthetics = c("fill","colour")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, linetype = 2) +
    ylab(expression("Fold change in"~italic(attP)~"concentration")) +
    geom_text(
      data = test_res_df %>% dplyr::mutate(`Biological replicate` = "6", Change = 0.525),
      aes(label = fmt_p_plotmath(p.adj)),
      colour = "black",
      parse = TRUE,
      inherit.aes = TRUE,
      size = 3,
      show.legend = FALSE,
      nudge_x = -0.4
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))
)
```

## Analyse transformation data

### Plot transformation data

Plot transformation data:

``` {r Parse transformation data}

transformation_df <-
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    read_csv("./experimental_data/transformation_rates_updated.csv"),
    read_csv("./experimental_data/deletions_with_CSP_three_replicates.csv") %>% 
      dplyr::filter(conditions == "Phage_Kan") %>% 
      dplyr::select(-conditions) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(mutants = gsub("_","+",donor)) %>% 
      dplyr::rename(deletion_rates = Transformation_efficiency),
    read_csv("./experimental_data/spontaneous_transformation_additional_replicates.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-Timepoint)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DNA =
                    dplyr::case_when(
                      mutants == "Control" ~ "No CSP or DNA",
                      mutants == "CSP_DnaseI" ~ "CSP and DNase",
                      mutants == "CSP" ~ "CSP, no DNA",
                      grepl("E99",mutants) ~ "1% pneumococcal",
                      grepl("E90",mutants) ~ "10% pneumococcal",
                      grepl("E50",mutants) ~ "50% pneumococcal",
                      grepl("E10",mutants) ~ "90% pneumococcal",
                      grepl("E1",mutants) ~ "99% pneumococcal"
                    )
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(DNA = factor(DNA,
                                 levels = c("1% pneumococcal", "10% pneumococcal", "50% pneumococcal", "90% pneumococcal", "99% pneumococcal",
                                            "No CSP or DNA", "CSP and DNase", "CSP, no DNA")
                                 )
                    ) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(`Experimental conditions` =
                    dplyr::case_when(
                      mutants == "Control" ~ "Control",
                      mutants == "CSP_DnaseI" ~ "Control",
                      mutants == "CSP" ~ "Control",
                      grepl("CSP",mutants) ~ "Induced competence",
                      TRUE ~ "Spontaneous competence"
                    )
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(DNA,`Experimental conditions`) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(`Biological replicate` = as.character(row_number())) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup()

```

### Calculate significance of differences between transformation data

``` {r Test for significance differences with transformation data}

analysis_df <- transformation_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Experimental conditions` != "Control") %>%
  dplyr::filter(DNA %in% dna_levels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    DNA = factor(DNA, levels = dna_levels),
    # optional log transform for plotting/interpretability
    log_rate = log10(deletion_rates + 1e-8)
  )

# Wilcoxon tests vs reference (1%) within each condition
wilcox_results <- analysis_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(`Experimental conditions`) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(
    log_rate ~ DNA,
    ref.group = "1% pneumococcal"
  ) %>%
  rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "holm") %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# y positions by condition x DNA for clean label placement
y_pos_df <- analysis_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y = dplyr::if_else(`Experimental conditions` == "Induced competence",
                max(deletion_rates, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.75,
                max(deletion_rates, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15
                )
)

# Calculate annotation positions
transf_annot_df <- wilcox_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    DNA = group2,              
    ref = group1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    y_pos_df,
    by = c("Experimental conditions", "DNA")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p.adj.signif), p.adj.signif != "ns") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = p.adj.signif)

```

### Plot transformation data

``` {r Plot transformation data}

(transformation_plot <- ggplot(

    shape = `Biological replicate`,
    group = interaction(mutants, `Experimental conditions`)
  )
) +
  geom_violin(

  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = competence_palette, aesthetics = c("fill", "colour")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = replicate_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA)
  ) +
  # significance labels (non-control only)
  geom_text(
    data = transf_annot_df,
    aes(
      x = DNA,
      y = y,
      label = label,
      colour = `Experimental conditions`
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5,

  )
)
```

``` {r Combined experimental data figure, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8}
                    )
```

## Phage packaging analysis

``` {bash, eval = FALSE}

# Install phageterm
pip install poetry
wget https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/ef/89/50321c714580c79d431cd9eb12aa62dc49e6f44afbe4e3efae282c9138ff/phagetermvirome-4.3.tar.gz
tar xfz phagetermvirome-4.3.tar.gz 
cd phagetermvirome-4.3 
poetry install
export PYTHONPATH=/Users/ncrouche/Documents/Recombination/packaging/phagetermvirome-4.3/phagetermvirome 
# Mapping to full genome
bwa index S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.dna
bwa aln S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.dna ERR124314_1.fastq > ERR124314_1.sai
bwa aln S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.dna ERR124314_2.fastq > ERR124314_2.sai
bwa sampe S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.dna ERR124314_1.sai ERR124314_2.sai  ERR124314_1.fastq ERR124314_2.fastq > S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.sam
samtools view -b S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.sam > S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.bam
rm S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.sam
sort S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.bam > sorted.S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.bam
samtools index sorted.S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.bam
# Prophage analysis
BAM="sorted.S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.bam"
REGION="S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant:25153-59080"
MAPQ=20
PREFIX="phiRMV8_region"
samtools index -@ 4 "$BAM"
samtools view -@ 4 -q $MAPQ -F 4 -F 256 -F 2048 "$BAM" "$REGION" | cut -f1 | sort -u > "${PREFIX}.qnames.txt"
samtools view -@ 4 -h -N "${PREFIX}.qnames.txt" -b "$BAM" > "${PREFIX}.pairs.bam"
samtools sort -@ 4 -n -o "${PREFIX}.pairs.name.bam" "${PREFIX}.pairs.bam"
samtools fastq -@ 4 -1 "${PREFIX}_R1.fastq.gz" -2 "${PREFIX}_R2.fastq.gz" -s "${PREFIX}_singletons.fastq.gz" -0 /dev/null -n "${PREFIX}.pairs.name.bam"
samtools faidx S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant.dna "S_pneumoniae_RMV8_dominant:25153-59080" > phiRMV8_region.fa
phageterm -f ../phiRMV8_region_R1.fastq.gz -p ../phiRMV8_region_R2.fastq.gz -r ../phiRMV8_region.fa --report_title=phiRMV8_analysis
# PRCI analysis
```
